title: repoplone repository.toml (spec 2)
description: Specification 2 of the repository.toml file read by repoplone. Selected by spec_version = "2". Packages are declared as a flat [[package]] array, each entry carrying a type. The [backend] and [frontend] component tables are gone, as are the keys spec 1 deprecated. Run `repoplone settings migrate` to convert a spec 1 file.

spec_version.description: Version of the repository.toml specification, as a string. Write "2", not 2.

package.description: Every package the repository releases, in document order.

changelog.description: Path to the repository changelog, relative to the repository root.

version.description: Path to the file holding the repository version.

container_images_prefix.description: Prefix for container images. The -backend and -frontend suffixes are appended.

compose.description: Docker Compose files. Spec 2 requires a list.

version_format.description: Versioning scheme used by the repository.

issues_url.description: URL where issues are tracked. Derived from the git origin when unset.

enabled.description: Whether the repository-level towncrier is enabled. Derived from the presence of this table.

section.description: Heading used for this section in the repository changelog.

settings.description: Path to the towncrier settings file.

release.description: Optional release pipeline configuration. When omitted, the default pipeline is used.

steps.description: Ordered step ids. Each is a built-in id or a key of the registry table. Spec 2 uses release_python and release_node; the spec 1 names release_backend and release_frontend are rejected.

registry.description: User-defined steps, keyed by step id.

releaseRegistryEntry.description: A user-defined release step bound to a built-in function.

function.description: Built-in step function this entry runs.

title.description: Title shown while the step runs. Defaults to the built-in title.

args.description: Keyword arguments passed to the step function. local_step requires entrypoint.

package.description: One package released from this repository. The language prefix of `type` decides how the package is built and published; the ecosystem suffix decides which extra keys apply.

type.description: Kind of package. `backend` and `frontend` are deprecated aliases for python-plone and node-volto, accepted so a hand-migrated file still loads; `repoplone settings migrate` writes the canonical names.

name.description: Package name, as published to PyPI or npm.

path.description: Path to the package, relative to the repository root. Use "." when the package is the repository itself.

changelog.description: Path to the package changelog, relative to the repository root.

towncrier_settings.description: Path to the package towncrier settings, relative to the repository root.

code_path.description: Path to the source code, relative to the package path.

publish.description: Whether to publish this package to its registry.

primary.description: Marks this package as the primary one of its family. At most one per family; the first in document order is primary when none is marked.

section.description: Heading used for this package in the repository changelog. Defaults to the package name.

base_package.description: Package this one builds on, whose version repoplone tracks. Only meaningful on the primary package of a family.

python_version.description: Base Python version. Read from the package classifiers when unset.

python_versions.description: Supported Python versions. Read from the package classifiers when unset.

plone_versions.description: Supported Plone versions. Read from the package classifiers when unset.

allOf.$comment: Node packages carry no Python or Plone version keys.
Generic packages have no ecosystem: no base package, no Plone versions.
node-aurora has no built-in base package default, so it must be declared.
